character.name:
Ashton Anton P. Montero (The Tank)
Physical: A tall, sturdy boy with short silver hair. He has a confident smirk and a calm, protective aura.

Cyber-Traditional Style: He wears heavy reinforced armor inspired by pre-colonial Filipino tribal warriors (like the Bagobo or Igorot armor), but made of matte grey steel with glowing green power strips.

Equipment: A massive heavy shield on his left arm and a short combat blade. His armor has visible thrusters for his [Taunt] ability.

Sprite Cues: Sturdy stance, shield always positioned slightly forward.
